name: after-hide
rationale: Deliberately unmodeled: a third, Vue-only emit after the leave motion completes, with no Angular or React counterpart and no demonstrated consumer need (YAGNI); a future task can add it if a real need arises.

name: contentTemplate
rationale: Deliberately unmodeled: the content-composition point (ng content template, react render prop, vue scoped slot) used by Table has no PropFact/EventFact shape and is left unmodeled rather than force-fit into either.

name: update:selection
rationale: v-model-only companion emitted with the identical payload alongside the modeled selection-change emit; it carries no independent semantic, so it is noted in the record header rather than double-counted as a fourth event.
